_note: SAMPLE recipes: replace or extend. Amounts are for `servings`. `unit` is what the cook sees (pc, bundle, pack, kg, g, tbsp, cup); cost converts it with the price table (pc uses piece_qty, g uses kg). `cost_qty` overrides that conversion in the price table's unit. Leave out salt, oil and water.

recipes.title: Sinigang na Bangus
recipes.description: Sour tamarind soup with milkfish and vegetables. A comforting way to use your bangus and kangkong before they spoil.
directions: Boil 8 cups of water with the tomatoes and onion for 10 minutes.
Add the radish and sampalok mix. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the bangus and siling haba. Cook on low heat for 8–10 minutes.
Add the sitaw, then the kangkong in the last 2 minutes. Season with patis.

recipes.title: Paksiw na Bangus
recipes.description: Milkfish simmered in vinegar, ginger and garlic. Keeps well for the next day.
directions: Arrange the ginger, garlic and onion in a pot, then lay the bangus on top.
Pour in the vinegar and 1 cup of water. Add the siling haba.
Bring to a boil without stirring, then simmer for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Ginisang Kangkong
recipes.description: Kangkong sautéed with garlic, onion and tomato. Ready in 15 minutes.
directions: Sauté the garlic, onion and tomato until soft.
Add the kangkong stems first, then the leaves.
Season with patis and cook for 2 more minutes.

recipes.title: Daing na Bangus
recipes.description: Butterflied milkfish marinated in vinegar and garlic, then fried until crisp.
directions: Marinate the bangus in vinegar, garlic, salt and pepper for at least 15 minutes.
Pat dry, then fry skin side down until golden, about 5 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Ensaladang Kamatis
recipes.description: Fresh tomato and onion salad that rescues tomatoes on their last day.
directions: Toss the tomatoes and onion in a bowl.
Squeeze in the kalamansi, add the patis, and mix. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Tinolang Manok
recipes.description: Ginger chicken soup with green papaya and malunggay.
directions: Sauté the ginger and onion, then add the chicken and brown lightly.
Season with patis, add 6 cups of water and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add the papaya and cook until tender, then the malunggay in the last minute.

recipes.title: Pork Adobo
recipes.description: Classic pork braised in soy sauce, vinegar and garlic.
directions: Combine everything with 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Simmer covered for 40 minutes, then uncover and reduce until glossy.

recipes.title: Tortang Kamatis
recipes.description: Soft tomato omelette, a quick way to use up tomatoes.
directions: Sauté the onion and tomatoes until soft, then let cool slightly.
Beat the eggs, mix in the tomatoes, and cook in a pan until set.

recipes.title: Pritong Tilapia
recipes.description: Crispy fried tilapia, best with ensaladang kamatis on the side.
directions: Score the tilapia, rub with salt, and pat dry.
Fry in hot oil until crisp, about 6 minutes per side. Serve with kalamansi.

recipes.title: Turon
recipes.description: Banana spring rolls with caramelized sugar, for bananas getting too ripe.
directions: Roll each banana half in brown sugar, then in a lumpia wrapper.
Fry until golden, sprinkling more sugar into the oil to caramelize.
